prompt: Fix TimestampSigner.unsign in src/itsdangerous/timed.py. For those malformed timestamps, preserve the original unsigned payload and leave date_signed unset; validate should return False and TimedSerializer.loads should report the library error. Preserve ordinary valid signatures, timestamp metadata for normal bad signatures, and expiration behavior. Make the smallest source change necessary; do not modify existing tests or add files. Verify with the existing tests.
